featured_reviews.name: Nehal Panchal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I truly don’t have enough words to express my gratitude to my trainer, Aman Sir.
For the past 7 years, I have been suffering from severe leg and ankle pain, along with swelling. I had almost lost hope and believed that my weight was the main reason behind all my problems. Because of this, I could only wear soft, comfort footwear and had accepted it as my reality.
But everything changed after I started training with him.
He didn’t just train me—he transformed my mindset and lifestyle. Every single day, he pushed me beyond my limits, counting each rep with me and ensuring I gave my best. Yes, there was pain, especially in my legs, but it was the kind of pain that builds strength, not breaks you.
Along with strength and body shape, he has also significantly improved my flexibility, which has made a huge difference in my daily movements and overall comfort.
Today, I feel stronger, more flexible, more confident, and happier from within. For the first time in years, I can wear normal footwear—and that itself feels like a huge achievement for me.
He guided me not just with workouts but also with a proper diet plan and constant motivation. At times, his guidance felt like lectures—but now I realize their true value. Even though I’ve implemented only 5% of what he has taught me, I can already see a major transformation in my life. I can only imagine what I can achieve if I follow it 100%.
Thank you, Aman Sir. Calling you a “life changer” or “transformer” still feels like an understatement.
“Thank you” is truly a small word for what you’ve done for me.
Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious!

featured_reviews.name: Raj Zaveri
featured_reviews.review_text:
The one star is solely for the staff, who have always been polite and helpful. Unfortunately, everything else about the gym has deteriorated significantly.
The overall condition and maintenance of the gym are extremely disappointing. Cleanliness has become a major concern, with the facility often appearing neglected and poorly maintained. Many of the machines and equipment are either heavily worn out, damaged, or rusted. While it is understandable that gym equipment undergoes wear and tear over time, failing to repair or replace them despite repeated complaints over several months reflects poorly on the management.
What is even more frustrating is that some of the machines that were fully functional when memberships were sold are now out of order. It is difficult to understand how a gym can justify charging members for facilities that are no longer available for use.
The gym has also been facing water seepage issues for over a year. Instead of addressing the root cause, a temporary tarpaulin sheet has been installed on the ceiling. Water still drips through during workouts, creating both inconvenience and safety concerns for members.
Running a gym undoubtedly involves significant costs, and members can appreciate that. However, consistently ignoring customer complaints and failing to maintain basic standards is unacceptable.
It is genuinely disappointing and disheartening to see a gym that was once well-regarded steadily decline to this extent. Unless serious attention is given to maintenance, cleanliness, and customer feedback, the experience is only likely to get worse.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Egym mithchowki vip section is a prime example of "all that glitters is not gold". I dnt knw why do they charge 8k for a month. Other gyms with better equipments and maintenance charge half the price. Well they say they have premium hammer strength equipments. Well honestly one who is new to the industry may buy that. Me being ages in this industry understood the equipments are not original just looking at them. The prime work for a leg extension machine is extension and flexion of the knee joint hence stretching and contracting quads. The hammer strength unilateral leg extension in the vip section allows to contract but stops at 90°, hence there isn't any stretch on the muscle. The shoulder press is not correct biomechanically. One side has more resistance than the other. The pendulum squat is weirdly designed where when one wants to go heavy the whole machine shakes and the safety fail arm which one can extend in case of failure is stuck for months, it doesn't work. So where is the safety?
All the machines are locally made, they kinda looks like gym80 or free motion machines. But they are not. Even the trainers over there told me straight forward that all machines are local made. And the hammer series is duplicate. The prime zone which is 4k monthly is much better than the vip, atleast people get jerai equipments.
The vip section having all red and black, and good lighting, doesn't make it premium. The benches are in so bad condition, I am literally scared to do heavy presses on them. There isn't any maintenance.
The seated machine lateral raise seat is broken for ages, so don't expect any stability.
The lat pull down hydraulic seat adjustment keeps going down and down when you perform the exercise, so forget of pressing against the quad support for pulling heavy.
The low row pulley when performed comes to the chest. I have to place a stepper on the seat everytime I need to use the equipment, which is again a safety hazard.

Well there are a lot more I can go on and on. But no point in complaining to the staff, they are doing their job and it's not in their hands. They are actually very nice people, starting from the reception to the floor trainers.
But I feel bad that the management dd put a price of 8k monthly for what? Hope the management sees this. And rectify these things, cz it's related to health and safety. It's no joke. If it would have been in some other country they would have been sued by now. I can say this cz I hve been to countries promoting fitness health and safety. But people are tolerant here and not everyone has the knowledge doesn't mean chain of gyms like this in such a big city will take advantage of it.
I am not going there anymore and urge people to save their hard earned money and not to compromise their safety just cz it's nearby and n join this branch. They can join the ijmima branch far better than this.
